result.title: Distilling Dense Trajectory Teachers For Large-Motion Video World Models
result.summary: Video world models are expected to generate videos that accurately follow specified camera trajectories while maintaining consistent 3D structures. However, existing models are predominantly trained on densely sampled videos with small inter-frame camera motions. When applied to sparse, large step trajectories, they often produce frozen frames, inaccurate camera motion, and severe geometric drift. We attribute this degradation to a mismatch between the gradual viewpoint transitions seen during training and the large viewpoint changes required at inference time. To address this problem, we propose Dense Trajectory Teacher Distillation (DTTD), a post-training framework that transfers a model's generation capability from dense trajectories to large camera motions. Given a sparse trajectory, DTTD interpolates additional camera poses to construct a dense trajectory covering the same path. The frozen base model then generates reliable teacher videos along this familiar dense trajectory, and pose aligned teacher observations are used to evaluate candidate videos generated under the original sparse trajectory. In this way, the model serves as its own generation teacher, requiring neither additional video data nor a stronger external video generator. We further combine dense teacher supervision with geometry aware rewards that assess cross frame consistency and camera trajectory following, and use the resulting preferences for offline preference optimization. To stably expand the model's motion range, we introduce a cumulative curriculum that progressively incorporates larger motion steps while retaining simpler trajectories to reduce capability forgetting.

AI.brief_summary: 针对视频世界模型在稀疏、大步长相机轨迹下出现帧冻结与几何漂移的问题，论文提出 Dense Trajectory Teacher Distillation：在稀疏轨迹间插值出稠密位姿，让冻结的基础模型沿稠密轨迹生成教师视频，再用位姿对齐的教师观测评价稀疏轨迹下的候选视频；并结合几何一致性奖励做离线偏好优化，以累积课程逐步扩大运动幅度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把稀疏大步长拆成稠密中间状态并由模型自生成教师信号」的做法，可能为 latent 推理中的中间状态监督与轨迹训练提供可核查线索，累积课程扩大步长也与长度泛化相关；但研究对象是视频生成而非 VLM 推理，关联需较多核查。
